fiberglass.coverage_note: Ruler excluded from material crop; no calibrated capture geometry or physical displacement inferred.

derivation_recipe.base_color: Neutral uncalibrated base: linearRGB=(.60+.22*(H-.5)).xxx; encode sRGB8. Color is authored from actual photo structure, not measured albedo.
derivation_recipe.crop_reason: Actual coarse550g/m2 rawglass cloth only; excludes ruler/coin/background boundary.
derivation_recipe.height: Decode sRGB to linear; Y=.2126R+.7152G+.0722B; d=Y-periodicFFTGaussian(Y,sigma24px); H=clamp(.5+.65*d/(percentile99(d)-percentile1(d)),0,1). Relative brightness surrogate, not measured geometry.
derivation_recipe.normal: Periodic central dH/du,dH/dv=(next-prev)*512; N=normalize(-.003*dHdu,-.003*dHdv,1); encodeRGB8. Constructed projectDirectX tangent convention, no measured normal claim.
derivation_recipe.roughness: round(255*(.48+.12*(1-H))); authored variation surrogate, not calibrated roughness.
derivation_recipe.tiling: Concatenate crop and X-mirror, then whole row and Y-mirror ->960square; Lanczos resize1024square. Mirrored repetition is explicit;1024output is not1024native unique photo detail.

fiberglass.identity_notes: Actual plain0/90 glass-fiber reinforcement cloth photograph by Cjp24, PD-self worldwide author release. Derived uncalibrated BC/N/R/relativeHeight; raw weave beneath independently authored resin response, not a cured-resin scan, calibrated reflectance or physical displacement.
